notes.text: Available in cPanel 136 and later; lists account backup archives in the selected account's home directory. fullpath duplicates the archive name and is not a promise of an absolute local file path. Status comes from the on-disk marker; archive presence does not establish completion of an active run.
sizeBytes is archive bytes and mtime is epoch seconds. startedAtEpoch alone is nullable; a null start time remains distinct from its omission. Empty archive lists remain empty.

All declared response fields are optional: omission stays distinct from zero, false, an empty string and explicit documented null. A missing or null data member is a payload mismatch. No general response-string enum or cross-field invariant validation is inferred.

The pinned operation omits x-readonly. Risk remains unknown and the generated client conservatively uses form POST, including inventory and progress methods; no read-only GET override or live probe is inferred. This method has no committed live evidence; follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.32 retains transport and payload verification.

Available in cPanel 136 and later; returns selected-account backup progress. The hook confirms complete only after the final published archive exists; without it, marker-based progress is an estimate. estimatedPercent is numeric and should be labeled estimated while running. Zero estimates can mean disk usage is unavailable, rather than no work.

Byte amounts and elapsed seconds remain integers. startedAtEpoch and finishedAtEpoch alone are nullable. A persistent complete state lasts until a new run or reset; this client neither waits nor resets it automatically.

Available in cPanel 136 and later; clears the selected account's authoritative backup run-state record. It is idempotent and does not cancel a running backup, delete an archive or prove completion; progress then reports live state. The client does not invoke this cleanup automatically.
cleared is a JSON boolean, not an integer 0/1 flag.
